Use case: style-transfer.
Asset:1536x1024 original warm hand-painted large-capital background for a Chinese city-builder.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET and desired neighbourhood content and irregular silhouette. Image2 is CAMERA/STYLE reference from another interior of this same game. The user now explicitly requests the large city to be TILTED/OBLIQUE LIKE THE OTHER INTERIORS, replacing the old strict north-up screen-aligned view.
Repaint the complete city from an elevated oblique three-quarter/isometric camera, looking diagonally down across roofs, like image2. Rotate the world ground axes roughly25-30degrees in the image and use moderate foreshortening: wall runs, streets, courtyards and roof ridges visibly recede diagonally, and building side walls are clearly visible. Real-world walls remain straight segments meeting at right angles, projected as diagonals on screen. This is a genuine camera/composition change, NOT a rotated flat image; buildings remain upright, towers vertical, perspective coherent. No top-down square frame or screen-aligned rectangular walls. Do not retain the old front-facing facade camera.
Retain the capital's warm sunlit ochre earth, warm stone, natural timber, blue-grey tile roofs, restrained golden red government hall, yellow-green foliage. Match the cleaner hand-painted2.5D village reference. Keep the asymmetric stepped outer wall following northwest wooded slope and a bent southern river, plus a separately walled inner administrative compound further back/right. Unequal wall lengths, a few broad offsets, long stretches with simple buttresses and modest gate towers. The resulting outline is an irregular inhabited town, not a perfect diamond or a symmetric box. Main southern gate and bridge in foreground slightly right of centre. Palace in upper-right/back as main visual focus. Layer buildings front to back with visible depth.
Neighbourhoods: small clustered residential roofs in the back/left; busier market lane west/centre with modest awnings; pond and vegetable gardens in the front-left; warehouses/workshops near the front gate; military courts right. Winding narrow lanes and shared dirt courts of varying widths, occasional stone paving, staggered L-shaped house groupings and trees. No regular grid or uniform rows. Camera frames the entire irregular town comfortably, without a horizon or a giant empty border.
IMPORTANT playable backdrop: keep aroundhalf the interior as natural open work courts interwoven between small fixed house clusters, enough to overlay31small interactive building sprites, each70-110px wide. Do not fill the city with buildings. Several distinct natural open courts in every neighbourhood, not identical pads or isolated enclosed squares. Fixed background houses should be small supporting architecture, about50-80px wide, with varied height/density. Preserve gardens, a well, pond and visibly connected streets as composition anchors.
No UI, labels, text, numbers, icons, decorative borders, building plot frames, fantasy glow or blossoms. Opaque continuous landscape. The oblique camera should be unmistakable and should feel like the village artwork in image2.

Use case: style-transfer. Repaint this exact warm ancient capital from a MORE DIAGONAL THREE-QUARTER CAMERA. The present image is still nearly front-on with mostly horizontal rear walls. The requested camera should be closer to an isometric strategy-city view: rotate the ground axes clearly, so one family of straight streets/walls rises about20-25degrees from left to right on screen, and the perpendicular world-space family recedes at about45-55degrees in the other direction. The outer city and inner palace compound must both visibly recede diagonally, like looking across a real model city from its southwest corner, NOT a frontal stage. Buildings stand upright with vertical posts, clear side facades and tiled roof volume; do not simply rotate the bitmap. Keep the broad asymmetric stepped city shape, not a perfect diamond. Preserve the warm color family, plain functional ancient Chinese architecture, northeast palace, northwest hillside, southwest pond/gardens, west market, southern warehouses, east military yards, naturally winding streets and bending river/bridge. Compose a wide city view with enough foreground and background depth. Preserve lots of naturally open ochre work courts (roughlyhalf the interior), separated by small supporting roof clusters, for31interactive building sprites later. Small scattered supporting houses, not overcrowded. Keep1536x1024, whole city within framing, no horizon, UI, text, labels, plot frames, glow, cherry blossoms or dense ornament. The oblique ground orientation must be unambiguous, approximately twice the diagonal angle seen in this edit target.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this exact1536x1024 oblique warm city, camera angle, every inner/outer wall, main palace, gates, river, bridge, roads, northwest rocks, southwest pond/gardens and most house clusters unchanged. This is a playable city-builder needing room for31interactive buildings. Selectively REMOVE ONLY these small roof groups and blend the ground seamlessly into natural ochre earth: (1) northwestern little housing compound centered x29%,y23%, just inside the north wall and west of the well; (2) small tall grey roof centered x33%,y33%, immediately east/northeast of the well; (3) small housing group centered x40%,y27%, east of the curved north-gate path; (4) the market-side small roof group centered x47%,y56%, east of the market awnings, but KEEP the major market awnings around x40%,y51%; (5) the middle/southern row of small warehouse roofs spanning x56%-66%,y59%-69%, just west of the curving lane to south gate; (6) the back row of the southeast barracks around x82%,y61%, but KEEP the east watchtower and foreground barracks near x86%,y68%; (7) the two house groups centered x76%,y46% and x69%,y49%, north of the eastern well court. Do not remove any other architecture. Leave these as naturally worn continuous work courts opening to the existing lanes, without individuallot frames, fences, rectangles or circles. Maintain all existing open courts too. No added buildings, new roads or new walls. Preserve asymmetry, diagonal camera and warm lighting exactly, no UI or text.
